main_result.statement: For any original-coordinate cut M=A[I,J] with Z2=e2(MM^T)>0, sup_s E|Q-s|^{-1/2} <= 8 e^(1/4) Z2^(-1/8), with arbitrary same-side quadratic and affine terms and no two-volume row-marginal hypothesis.
main_result.proof_key: If two-volume row marginals are spread, use pinned D2 critical |t|^-1 envelope. If a row is heavy, promote it to a genuine hub; exact identity ||m||^2 F^2=alpha_i Z2. If projected one-volume is spread, grouped crossing (1,1) closes; if not, promote one more physical row to an exact rank-two crossing. Recursion terminates after two promotions.

square_receiver.statement: After exact completion at physical diagonal d!=0, if the Schur residual has a cut with two-volume Z2>0, then ||p_Q||_infty <= 8e^(1/4)|d|^-1/2 Z2^-1/8 = 8e^(1/4)(|d|^4 Z2)^-1/8, hence linear interval small-ball. Continuity separate.

partner_application.result: Partner effective-dimension compiler applied at d=2,K=2pi/N^2 gives E|R_N-R_N'|^-1/2<=16/(3N), ||p_RN||_2^2<=4/N^2, and P(|R_N-R_N'|<=eps)<=8eps/N^2. Direct one-copy Riesz plus square gives ||p_QN||_infty<=8/sqrt(N).

first_unpaid_implication: From the remaining s3(A)>=1 no-pivot/hub survivor, extract product-preservingly either a physical square and Schur cut with |d|^4 Z2>=c>0, or an already-paid zero-diagonal/grouped-hub/rank-three-crossing/low-rank-carrier exit. Two-volume row marginals are no longer part of the debt.
corrections_preserved: no conditional cap for conjugate sum/difference
